import json
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean
import subprocess
from runpy import run_path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.metrics import get_scorer
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn_genetic import GAFeatureSelectionCV
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

root = Path("benchmarks/results/performance-v2")
setup = run_path(str(root / "known-support.py"))

def compare(X, y, test, labels, cv, model, metric, seed, pair_coverage, score_guided,
            signal=None, forward=False):
    budget = 24
    width = X.shape[1]
    result = {"seed": seed}
    search = GAFeatureSelectionCV(model, max_features=4, population_size=6, generations=3,
        scoring=metric, cv=cv, random_state=seed, error_score="raise", n_jobs=1, verbose=False).fit(X,y)
    observed = dict()
    for mask, score in zip(search.cv_results_["features"],search.cv_results_["mean_test_score"]):
        observed.setdefault(tuple(np.flatnonzero(mask).tolist()),float(score))
    assert len(observed) == search.fit_stats_["cross_validate_calls"] and len(observed)>=budget
    genetic = dict(list(observed.items())[:budget])
    for method in ("genetic","random_four","partition_four"):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 18000)
        h = dict(genetic) if method=="genetic" else {}
        while len(h)<budget:
            perm = rng.permutation(width).tolist()
            starts = range(0,width-3,4) if method=="partition_four" else [0]
            for pos in starts:
                cols = tuple(sorted(perm[pos:pos+4]))
                if cols in h: continue
                h[cols] = float(cross_val_score(model, X[:,cols], y, cv=cv, scoring=metric,
                                                n_jobs=1,error_score="raise").mean())
                if len(h)==budget: break
        winner=max(h,key=lambda c:(h[c],-len(c)))
        refit=clone(model).fit(X[:,winner],y)
        record=dict(winner=winner,cv=h[winner],
                    holdout=float(get_scorer(metric)(refit,test[:,winner],labels)),
                    covered_pairs=len({p for c in h for p in combinations(c,2)}),
                    trajectory=[dict(columns=c,cv=v) for c,v in h.items()])
        if signal is not None:
            record["pair_proposed"]=any(set(signal)<=set(c) for c in h)
            record["pair_selected"]=set(signal)<=set(winner)
        result[method]=record
    return result

# Reuse the published dataset/split builders, replacing the policy comparison only.
for fn in ("run_pair","run_real"):
    setup[fn].__globals__["compare"]=compare
with threadpool_limits(1):
    rows=[setup["run_pair"](seed,interact) for seed in range(8101,8105) for interact in (False,True)]
    rows += [setup["run_real"](task,split,seed) for task in ("wine","diabetes")
             for split in (8111,8112) for seed in (8121,8122)]
for task in sorted({r["task"] for r in rows}):
    subset=[r for r in rows if r["task"]==task]
    for method in ("genetic","random_four","partition_four"):
        print(task,method,round(mean(r[method]["holdout"] for r in subset),5),
              mean(r[method]["covered_pairs"] for r in subset),
              sum(r[method].get("pair_selected",False) for r in subset))
out=root/"partition-four-pilot.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(dict(library_commit=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
    reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf8"),rows=rows),allow_nan=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf8")
